spec: ISA 0.9 §§4.7,9.4,11 K64 and §11.1 K24/K25 classical pseudo-location preparation; bennett-sched-r28
derivation: One i2 argument a=3 emits acquire, X(bit0), X(bit1) before all State acquisitions; reverse X(bit1), X(bit0), release follows all State releases. With B=0 there are five State records and no frame, giving the exact construct/release generated ordinals in trace.json. The argument allocation is clean construction workspace with library_scratch=false; State allocations retain their existing library-scratch marks. The pointer/binary64 vectors prepare exact bits even for unused arguments; tokens allocate nothing.
